# Command Deck reference

Commands run server-side against stored evidence and are checked against the caller's permissions. Missing arguments are prompted for interactively; `cancel` aborts a prompt. Tab completion is context-aware.

## analysis

| Command | Summary | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `dns inspect [--limit int]` | DNS transactions, latency and errors | `console:use` |
| `flow inspect <flow>` | Details of one conversation | `console:use` |
| `flows list [--limit int] [--state word] [--ip ip] [--port int] [--transport word]` | List conversations, most suspicious first | `console:use` |
| `http inspect [--limit int]` | HTTP requests, status codes and timing | `console:use` |
| `tcp handshakes` | Handshake statistics and failures | `console:use` |
| `tcp resets [--limit int]` | TCP resets and who sent them | `console:use` |
| `tcp retransmissions [--limit int]` | Retransmissions per conversation | `console:use` |
| `timeline show <flow>` | Key packet events of a conversation | `console:use` |
| `tls inspect [--limit int]` | TLS handshakes, versions, certificates and alerts | `console:use` |

## capture

| Command | Summary | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `pcap inspect [capture]` | Validate, analyse (if needed) and summarise a capture | `console:use` |
| `pcap list [--limit int] [--mode word]` | List captures in your tenant | `console:use` |
| `pcap protocols` | Protocol distribution | `console:use` |
| `pcap stats` | Capture statistics and top endpoints | `console:use` |
| `pcap upload` | Upload a PCAP/PCAPNG file as evidence | `capture:upload` |
| `pcap use <capture>` | Select the capture that other commands work on | `console:use` |

## f5

| Command | Summary | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `f5 correlate [--with capture] [--config word]` | Correlate client-side and server-side flows through a BIG-IP | `correlation:run` |

## findings

| Command | Summary | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `evidence show <finding>` | Packets and observations behind a finding | `console:use` |
| `finding inspect <finding>` | Full finding: evidence, hypothesis, alternatives, verification | `console:use` |
| `finding status <finding> <status> [note]` | Set finding status (confirm requires a verification note) | `finding:update` |
| `findings list [--limit int] [--severity word] [--status word]` | Findings for the selected capture | `console:use` |

## general

| Command | Summary | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `clear` | Clear the screen | `console:use` |
| `help [command]` | Show commands, or details for one command | `console:use` |
| `history` | Show recent commands | `console:use` |
| `status` | Operator level, selected capture, analysis and mission status | `console:use` |
| `whoami` | Show your identity, tenant and permissions | `console:use` |

## missions

| Command | Summary | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `mission list` | List training missions | `console:use` |
| `mission start <mission>` | Start a training mission | `mission:play` |
| `mission status` | Objectives of the active mission | `console:use` |
| `mission submit <objective> <answer>` | Answer a mission objective | `mission:play` |

## reports

| Command | Summary | Permission |
|---|---|---|
| `export findings [--format word]` | Export findings (JSON or CSV) | `export:data` |
| `report generate [--format word]` | Generate an evidence-linked report | `report:create` |
